about: Invented sample projects shown when Threadline is not running on this computer.

chats.title: Log the retry loop and find the refund bug

exchanges.user: It must run inside the existing nightly job, no new services.
exchanges.agent: Understood. The matcher runs as a step in nightly_job.py.

exchanges.user: Point the integration tests at staging: postgres://matcher:[REDACTED]@db.staging.internal:5432/payments
exchanges.agent: The integration tests now read the staging database URL from the environment instead of the code.

exchanges.user: Can you add logging around the retry loop?
exchanges.agent: Added logging around the retry loop. test_partial_refund still fails: refunds are matched to the wrong invoice when two invoices share an amount.

exchanges.user: Skip Redis for now, an in-memory dict is fine.
exchanges.agent: Using an in-memory dict for invoice lookups.

exchanges.user: No wait, dates must be UTC everywhere, not local time.
exchanges.agent: Switched every payment date to UTC and updated the fixtures. Hit the usage limit before running the full suite.

exchanges.user: We need to match bank transfers to invoices automatically.
exchanges.agent: Proposed a matcher that compares amount, date and reference. Option B keeps the old API.

exchanges.user: The goal is that onboarding finishes in under 30 seconds.
exchanges.agent: Cut onboarding to three screens. The permissions screen still takes 12 seconds on older phones.

exchanges.user: Go with option B, the native stack.
exchanges.agent: Switched to the native stack navigator and removed the old one.

chats.title: Share date helpers between the app and the API

exchanges.user: Put the date helpers in one place both can use.
exchanges.agent: Moved the date helpers into shared/dates.ts and pointed both projects at it.

chats.title: Make the loader work on Windows

exchanges.user: Whatever we do, it needs to run on Windows too.
exchanges.agent: Replaced the shell scripts with Python so the loader runs on Windows. Path handling in export.py is next.

exchanges.user: Use Parquet, not CSV, for the daily exports.
exchanges.agent: Daily exports now write Parquet files.
